page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with 1 thread per core. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge generally falls into the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU tests via stress-ng and Geekbench rank in the bottom 10% to 25%. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large-block memory write bandwidth and Passmark CPU extended instructions achieve average tier results. Cryptographic and database operation benchmarks, including Redis SET operations, consistently register in the bottom 25%. LLM inference speeds are average for small 135M models but drop to poor for larger 7B models.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage. The absence of local storage means workloads must rely on network-attached storage. The instance is best suited for memory-intensive applications with moderate CPU requirements, such as caching layers, small-to-medium database hosting, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
